key.name: indicator-style
key.description: What the panel indicator shows: the gauge icon with the headline percentage, the icon alone, or the percentage alone.

key.name: headline-metric
key.description: Which usage window the panel percentage reports: the most constrained window (auto), the session window, or the weekly window.

key.name: warning-percent
key.description: Usage percentage at which the indicator enters the warning state. Kept strictly below critical-percent.

key.name: critical-percent
key.description: Usage percentage at which the indicator enters the critical state. Kept strictly above warning-percent.

key.name: refresh-interval-seconds
key.description: Background poll cadence. The UI offers 30, 60, 120, 300, or 600 seconds; other stored values snap to the nearest choice.
